questions.stem:
(a) Show that \(x+2\) divides \(2x^3+3x^2-4x-4\).

(b) Jane claims that all the roots of the cubic are rational. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
(a) 證明 \(x+2\) 是 \(2x^3+3x^2-4x-4\) 的因式。

(b) Jane 認為此三次式的根全是有理數。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) At \(x=-2\) the value is \(-16+12+8-4=0\), so the factor theorem applies.

(b) Division gives \(2x^2-x-2\). Its discriminant is 17, so its roots \((1\pm\sqrt{17})/4\) are irrational. The linear factor gives \(-2\). Jane is incorrect.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 代入 \(x=-2\) 得 \(-16+12+8-4=0\)，由因式定理即得證。

(b) 商式為 \(2x^2-x-2\)，判別式為 17，兩根 \((1\pm\sqrt{17})/4\) 均是無理數。一次因式的根是 \(-2\)，故不同意。

questions.stem:
A cubic \(P(x)\) leaves remainder \(4x+8\) when divided by \(x^2-4x-12\).

(a) Is \(x+2\) a factor? Explain.

(b) The leading coefficient is 2 and division by \(x^2+4x+4\) leaves the same remainder. (i) Factorise \(P(x)\). (ii) For which real \(k\) does the graph of \(y=P(x)-k(x+2)\) cut the horizontal axis at only one point?
questions.stemZh:
三次式 \(P(x)\) 被 \(x^2-4x-12\) 除所得餘式為 \(4x+8\)。

(a) \(x+2\) 是否其因式？解釋。

(b) 首項係數為 2，且被 \(x^2+4x+4\) 除所得餘式相同。(i) 因式分解 \(P(x)\)。(ii) 若 \(y=P(x)-k(x+2)\) 的圖像只在一點切過橫軸，求實數 \(k\) 的範圍。
questions.solution:
(a) At \(-2\) the divisor and remainder both vanish. Thus \(P(-2)=0\).

(b)(i) Subtract \(4(x+2)\) from \(P\). Both \((x+2)(x-6)\) and \((x+2)^2\) divide the difference. As it is cubic with leading coefficient 2, it equals \(2(x+2)^2(x-6)\). Hence \[\begin{gathered}P=2(x+2)\\{}\cdot (x^2-4x-10)\end{gathered}\].

(ii) The second factor after removing \(x+2\) is \(2x^2-8x-20-k\), with discriminant \(8(k+28)\). There is exactly one intersection if \(k<-28\). At \(k=-28\) there is also a tangency at 2. At \(k=4\) the root \(-2\) is double and the other root is 6. Thus if “cut” counts only crossings and excludes tangencies, both exceptional values also qualify.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 代入 \(-2\)，除式和餘式均為零，故 \(P(-2)=0\)。

(b)(i) 從 \(P\) 減去 \(4(x+2)\)。差式可被 \((x+2)(x-6)\) 和 \((x+2)^2\) 整除。由次數及首項係數得差式為 \(2(x+2)^2(x-6)\)，故 \[\begin{gathered}P=2(x+2)\\{}\cdot (x^2-4x-10)\end{gathered}\]。

(ii) 抽出 \(x+2\) 後，另一因式為 \(2x^2-8x-20-k\)，判別式為 \(8(k+28)\)。若只得一個交點，則 \(k<-28\)。當 \(k=-28\)，圖像另在 2 處相切。當 \(k=4\)，\(-2\) 為二重根，另一根為 6。若「切過」只計穿越而不計相切，這兩個特殊值亦符合。

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=x^3-10x^2\\{}-3x-63k\end{gathered}\] with \(k\) a positive integer. The polynomial \(f(x+k)\) is divisible by \(x-2k\).

(a) Find \(k\). (b) Someone claims that \(f(x)=0\) has three real roots. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=x^3-10x^2\\{}-3x-63k\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(k\) 為正整數。已知 \(f(x+k)\) 可被 \(x-2k\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(k\)。(b) 有人認為 \(f(x)=0\) 有三個實根。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Substituting \(2k\) gives \(f(3k)=0\), or \(9k(k-4)(3k+2)=0\). Only 4 is a positive integer.

(b) The known root is 12. Division by \(x-12\) gives \(x^2+2x+21\), whose discriminant is \(-80\). There is only one real root.

questions.stem:
A cubic \(f(x)\) leaves remainders \(\alpha\) and \(2x-4\) on division by \(x-\alpha\) and \((x-\alpha)(x-9)\) respectively.

(a) Find \(\alpha\).

(b) Given \(f(0)=-220\) and \(f(5)=-30\), (i) factorise \(f(x)\) and (ii) decide whether all its roots are rational, giving a reason.

(c) Let \(g(x)=f(x)+k\). (i) Find \(k\) if \(x-3\) divides \(g(x)\). (ii) Factorise \(g(x)\).
questions.stemZh:
三次式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-\alpha\) 和 \((x-\alpha)(x-9)\) 除所得餘式分別為 \(\alpha\) 和 \(2x-4\)。

(a) 求 \(\alpha\)。

(b) 已知 \(f(0)=-220\) 及 \(f(5)=-30\)。(i) 因式分解 \(f(x)\)。(ii) 各根是否均為有理數？解釋。

(c) 設 \(g(x)=f(x)+k\)。(i) 若 \(x-3\) 為其因式，求 \(k\)。(ii) 因式分解 \(g(x)\)。
questions.solution:
(a) At \(\alpha\), the remainders agree, so \(\alpha=2\alpha-4\) and \(\alpha=4\).

(b) Write \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-4)(x-9)\\{}\cdot (px+q)+2x-4\end{gathered}\]. At zero, \(36q-4=-220\), giving \(q=-6\). At 5, \(-4(5p-6)+6=-30\), so \(p=3\). Extract \(x-2\) to get \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-2)\\{}\cdot (3x^2-39x+110)\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic has discriminant 201, positive and not a square. Its two roots are irrational.

(c) \(f(3)=20\), so \(k=-20\). Dividing \(f-20\) by \(x-3\) gives \(3x^2-36x+80\). Therefore \[\begin{gathered}g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (3x^2-36x+80)\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 在 \(\alpha\) 處兩餘式相等，故 \(\alpha=2\alpha-4\)，得 \(\alpha=4\)。

(b) 設 \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-4)(x-9)\\{}\cdot (px+q)+2x-4\end{gathered}\]。代入零得 \(36q-4=-220\)，即 \(q=-6\)。代入 5 得 \(-4(5p-6)+6=-30\)，故 \(p=3\)。抽出 \(x-2\) 得 \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-2)\\{}\cdot (3x^2-39x+110)\end{gathered}\]。二次因式的判別式 201 為正且不是完全平方數，故有兩個無理根。

(c) \(f(3)=20\)，所以 \(k=-20\)。以 \(x-3\) 除 \(f-20\) 得商式 \(3x^2-36x+80\)，故 \[\begin{gathered}g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (3x^2-36x+80)\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem:
The remainders when \(f,g\) are divided by \(2x+1\) are \(R_1,R_2\) respectively, with \(R_1=kR_2\) for nonzero constant \(k\).

(a) Show that \(2x+1\) divides \(f-kg\).

(b) Find the two remainders for \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=4x^4-7x^3\\{}-10x^2+11x+8\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=x^4+2x^3\\{}-x^2-24x-11\end{gathered}\].
questions.stemZh:
多項式 \(f,g\) 被 \(2x+1\) 除所得餘式分別為 \(R_1,R_2\)，其中 \(R_1=kR_2\)，而 \(k\) 為非零常數。

(a) 證明 \(2x+1\) 是 \(f-kg\) 的因式。

(b) 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=4x^4-7x^3\\{}-10x^2+11x+8\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=x^4+2x^3\\{}-x^2-24x-11\end{gathered}\]。求兩餘式。
questions.solution:
(a) Put \(t=-1/2\). Then \[\begin{gathered}f(t)-kg(t)\\{}=R_1-kR_2\\{}=0\end{gathered}\], proving divisibility by the factor theorem.

(b) At \(t\), the terms of \(f\) in eighths have numerators 2, 7, −20, −44 and 64. Their sum gives \(9/8\). For \(g\) in sixteenths the numerators are 1, −4, −4, 192 and −176, giving \(9/16\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 設 \(t=-1/2\)。由 \[\begin{gathered}f(t)-kg(t)\\{}=R_1-kR_2\\{}=0\end{gathered}\]，按因式定理即得證。

(b) 把 \(t\) 代入 \(f\) 並通分至分母 8，各分子為 2、7、−20、−44、64，故餘式為 \(9/8\)。代入 \(g\) 並通分至分母 16，各分子為 1、−4、−4、192、−176，故餘式為 \(9/16\)。

questions.stem:
Dividing \(g(x)\) by \(x^2+2x+a\) gives quotient \(x+13\) and remainder \(b(x-3)\), where \(a,b\) are constants. The polynomial \(g\) is divisible by \(x-3\).

(a) Find \(a\). (b) Is there only one possible \(b\) for which at least two roots of \(g(x)=0\) coincide? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
以 \(x^2+2x+a\) 除 \(g(x)\)，商式為 \(x+13\)，餘式為 \(b(x-3)\)，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。已知 \(g\) 可被 \(x-3\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(a\)。(b) 若 \(g(x)=0\) 至少有兩根相等，\(b\) 是否只有一個可能值？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) At 3 the remainder vanishes. Thus \(16(15+a)=0\), giving \(a=-15\).

(b) Extracting the known factor gives \[\begin{gathered}g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (x^2+18x+65+b)\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic can have a repeated root, which requires \(4(16-b)=0\), so \(b=16\). Alternatively it can share the root 3, which requires \(128+b=0\), so \(b=-128\). Both values work.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 代入 3，餘式為零，得 \(16(15+a)=0\)，故 \(a=-15\)。

(b) 抽出已知因式得 \[\begin{gathered}g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (x^2+18x+65+b)\end{gathered}\]。若二次因式有二重根，判別式 \(4(16-b)=0\)，得 \(b=16\)。若二次因式亦有根 3，則 \(128+b=0\)，得 \(b=-128\)。故有兩個可能值。

questions.stem: Find the L.C.M. of \[\begin{gathered}(x-2)^4(x+3)\\{}\cdot (2x-5)^2\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}(2-x)^3(3+x)\\{}\cdot (5+2x)^2\end{gathered}\].
questions.stemZh: 求 \[\begin{gathered}(x-2)^4(x+3)\\{}\cdot (2x-5)^2\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}(2-x)^3(3+x)\\{}\cdot (5+2x)^2\end{gathered}\] 的最小公倍式。
questions.solution: \(2-x=-(x-2)\) and \(3+x=x+3\). Take the maximum power of every distinct factor: \[\begin{gathered}(x+3)(x-2)^4\\{}\cdot (2x-5)^2\\{}\cdot (5+2x)^2\end{gathered}\]. The factors \(2x-5\) and \(2x+5\) are different.
questions.solutionZh: \(2-x=-(x-2)\)、\(3+x=x+3\)。各相異因式取最高次方，得 \[\begin{gathered}(x+3)(x-2)^4\\{}\cdot (2x-5)^2\\{}\cdot (5+2x)^2\end{gathered}\]。注意 \(2x-5\) 與 \(2x+5\) 並非同一因式。

questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=x^4\\{}-ax^3+bx-8\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are constants. Division by \(x-2\) gives remainder \(-2\). Find the remainder on division by \(x+2\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=x^4\\{}-ax^3+bx-8\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。它被 \(x-2\) 除時餘式為 \(-2\)。求被 \(x+2\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: The odd-power terms cancel in \(f(2)+f(-2)=16\). Since \(f(2)=-2\), the required remainder is \(f(-2)=16-(-2)=18\).

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=8x^3\\{}+ax^2-11x+b\end{gathered}\]. Its remainder on division by \(x-1\) is6, and it is divisible by \(2x-1\).

(a) Find \(a,b\).

(b) Find the quotient on division by \(2x-1\).

(c) Paul claims \(f(x)=0\) has irrational roots. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=8x^3\\{}+ax^2-11x+b\end{gathered}\]。它被 \(x-1\) 除時餘式為6，且可被 \(2x-1\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(a,b\)。

(b) 求被 \(2x-1\) 除時的商式。

(c) Paul 聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 有無理根。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) \(f(1)=6\) gives \(a+b=9\); \(f(1/2)=0\) gives \(a+4b=18\). Thus \(a=6,b=3\).

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f=(2x-1)\\{}\cdot (4x^2+5x-3)\end{gathered}\], so the quotient is \(4x^2+5x-3\).

(c) Its roots are \(1/2\) and \((-5\pm\sqrt{73})/8\). Since 73 is positive and not a square, the latter two are irrational. Agree.
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials reviews 4.pdf · 第15題

questions.stem:
Let \(f(x)\) be cubic with \(f(1)=f(-4)=0\), \(f(-1)=6\) and \(f(2)=30\).

(a) Factorise \(f(x)\).

(b) Let \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=2x^3+11x^2\\{}+13x+4\end{gathered}\]. Simplify \(\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}-\frac{g(x)}{f(x)}\).
questions.solution:
(a) Put \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-1)(x+4)\\{}\cdot (ax+b)\end{gathered}\]. The values at \(-1,2\) give \(a-b=1\) and \(2a+b=5\), hence \(a=2,b=1\). Thus \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-1)(x+4)\\{}\cdot (2x+1)\end{gathered}\].

(b) \[\begin{gathered}g=(x+1)(x+4)\\{}\cdot (2x+1)\end{gathered}\]. The expression becomes \[\begin{gathered}\frac{x-1}{x+1}-\frac{x+1}{x-1}\\=\frac{4x}{1-x^2}\end{gathered}\]. Retain all original exclusions \(x\ne1,-1,-4,-1/2\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 設 \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-1)(x+4)\\{}\cdot (ax+b)\end{gathered}\]。代入 \(-1,2\) 得 \(a-b=1\)、\(2a+b=5\)，解得 \(a=2,b=1\)。所以 \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-1)(x+4)\\{}\cdot (2x+1)\end{gathered}\]。

(b) \[\begin{gathered}g=(x+1)(x+4)\\{}\cdot (2x+1)\end{gathered}\]，原式化為 \[\begin{gathered}\frac{x-1}{x+1}-\frac{x+1}{x-1}\\=\frac{4x}{1-x^2}\end{gathered}\]。保留全部原有限制 \(x\ne1,-1,-4,-1/2\)。

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=6x^3\\{}+5x^2+px+q\end{gathered}\]. The factor \(x-3\) divides \(f(x)\). Division by \(x^2-9\) gives remainder \(kx+99\).

(a) Find \(k,p,q\).

(b) How many rational roots does \(f(x)=0\) have? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=6x^3\\{}+5x^2+px+q\end{gathered}\]，且 \(x-3\) 是因式。它被 \(x^2-9\) 除時餘式為 \(kx+99\)。

(a) 求 \(k,p,q\)。

(b) 方程 \(f(x)=0\) 有多少個有理根？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) At 3, \(3k+99=0\), so \(k=-33\). Then \(f(3)=0\) gives \(3p+q=-207\), while \(f(-3)=198\) gives \(-3p+q=315\). Hence \(p=-87,q=54\).

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (6x^2+23x-18)\\{}=(x-3)(2x+9)\\{}\cdot (3x-2)\end{gathered}\]. Its3 roots \[\begin{gathered}3,-9/2,2/3\end{gathered}\] are rational.

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=ax^3\\{}-x^2-6x+2b\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are nonzero constants. It is divisible by \(ax^2-5x+b\).

(a)(i) Show that \(x+2\) divides \(f(x)\). (ii) Find \(a,b\).

(b) How many rational roots does \(f(x)=0\) have? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=ax^3\\{}-x^2-6x+2b\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 均為非零常數。它可被 \(ax^2-5x+b\) 整除。

(a)(i) 證明 \(x+2\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的因式。(ii) 求 \(a,b\)。

(b) 方程 \(f(x)=0\) 有多少個有理根？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) Let the quotient be \(px+q\). Comparing leading coefficients gives \(ap=a\), so \(p=1\); comparing constants gives \(bq=2b\), so \(q=2\). Therefore \(f=(x+2)(ax^2-5x+b)\).

(ii) Compare the remaining coefficients: \(2a-5=-1\), \(b-10=-6\). Thus \(a=2,b=4\).

(b) The quadratic \(2x^2-5x+4\) has discriminant \(25-32=-7<0\). Only \(x=-2\) is real, so exactly one root is rational.
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials reviews 4.pdf · 第20題

questions.stem: Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M., respectively, of \(9a^5b^3c^2\), \(21a^4bc^3\) and \(7ab^6c^5\).
questions.stemZh: 依次求 \(9a^5b^3c^2\)、\(21a^4bc^3\) 及 \(7ab^6c^5\) 的最大公因式及最小公倍式。
questions.solution: The numerical GCD is1 and LCM is63. Minimum variable powers give \(abc^2\); maximum powers give \(a^5b^6c^5\). Thus HCF \(abc^2\), LCM \(63a^5b^6c^5\).
questions.solutionZh: 數字最大公因數為1，最小公倍數為63。各字母最低次方給 \(abc^2\)，最高次方給 \(a^5b^6c^5\)。故最大公因式為 \(abc^2\)，最小公倍式為 \(63a^5b^6c^5\)。
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/polynomials reviews.pdf · 第9題

questions.stem: \(\frac{8-8x}{3x^2+14x-5}=\frac A{x+5}+\frac B{3x-1}\), where \(A,B\) are constants. Find \((A,B)\).
questions.solution: Factor the denominator as \((x+5)(3x-1)\). Clearing it gives \[\begin{gathered}8-8x=A(3x-1)\\{}+B(x+5)\end{gathered}\]. Setting \(x=-5\) and \(x=1/3\) gives \(A=-3,B=1\). The rational identity excludes \(-5,1/3\).

questions.stem: Find the quotient and remainder when \(7x^2-8x+2x^3-1\) is divided by \(x^2+2\).
questions.solution: First order the dividend as \(2x^3+7x^2-8x-1\). The leading quotient term is \(2x\); subtracting leaves \(7x^2-12x-1\). The next term is7; subtraction leaves \(-12x-15\). Thus quotient \(2x+7\), remainder \(-12x-15\).
